title: The day's paid-run cap and spend live outside relay
what: relay keeps the owner's daily cap for paid runs (projects.toml [global], e.g. paid_cap_usd_per_day, changed by one command) and computes the day's spend from its own records (the eval records bin/eval-record stores and the bench reports); `bin/paid-cost today` prints spend, cap and run count; bin/ci's paid step and relay bench refuse to start a run whose estimate (the largest measured run of that kind) would pass the cap, naming the cap, the spend and the estimate.
why: Owner, verbatim: "Добавь в очередь пункт про предел за день в relay". On 24 Oct the cap was raised three times ($75, $100, $200) and lived only in Claude's memory; the day's spend ("about $70") was an estimate from the handover, since no command sums it. Another machine or session without that memory has no cap at all.
failing_case: 24 Oct: no relay command prints the day's paid spend; the cap $200 is written only in ~/.claude/projects/-Users-amidman-relay/memory/paid-checks-preapproved.md; bin/paid-cost has only `ceiling` and `estimate`.
pass_cases: `bin/paid-cost today` on fixture records prints the summed spend, the run count and the cap; a paid bin/ci or relay bench whose estimate would pass the cap is refused before it starts with that line; with spend + estimate under the cap it runs; the cap is read from projects.toml, not from Claude memory.
where: projects.toml [global], bin/paid-cost, bin/ci (plugin evals step), lib/relay_bench.py
